keyVerseDR: "...the wheat gather ye into my barn." (Mt 13:30)

level1.title: Tiny Seed, Big Tree
level1.story: Jesus said the Kingdom is like a tiny mustard seed. It grows into a big tree! Birds come to rest in its branches.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did the tiny seed become?
How can you grow in love?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me grow in Your love. Amen.

activity.title: The mustard tree
activity.intro: Write or draw one thing you thank God for on each leaf.
activity.label: From a tiny seed, a big tree!

level2.title: Wheat and Weeds
level2.story: Jesus told a parable about a man who sowed good seed in his field. While everyone slept, an enemy sowed weeds among the wheat. The servants asked if they should pull the weeds, but he said, "Let them grow together until the harvest." Jesus also said the kingdom is like a tiny mustard seed that grows into a large tree, and like yeast that makes the dough rise. At the harvest, the wheat will be gathered into God's barn.
level2.keyLine: The wheat gather ye into my barn.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did the farmer wait until harvest?
How is God patient with us?
level2.prayer: Lord, make me wheat for Your harvest. Amen.

activity.title: Wheat or weeds?
activity.intro: Sort each one: does it help God's kingdom grow or not?
